source: tests/probe.py (live run, headless Chromium, natural keyboard input, x,y recorded via rooftop.scene state)

cases.name: M2 unreachable from street directly below
cases.method: walk(5020) on continuous street (feet=1000), press E

cases.name: M2 unreachable from street at multiple x offsets
cases.method: verified geometrically in tests/level.test.mjs against x in [4300, p2.x-50, p2.x, p2.x+50, 5649], all at feet=1000

cases.name: M2 unreachable from roof-e2 (horizontally closest adjacent deck, 96px below)
cases.method: teleport to (4950, body.bottom=896 i.e. standing on roof-e2), press E
cases.expected: no puzzle opens (vertical 96px gap exceeds the 48px tolerance even though horizontal 70px gap is within the 115px tolerance)

cases.name: M2 unreachable from roof-e1 and roof-e4 (geometric check)
cases.method: verified in tests/level.test.mjs for every x along each deck's span

cases.name: M2 reachable from the intended roof-e3 position
cases.method: climb ladder (x=4900) to roof-e3, walk to x=5020, press E

cases.name: Puzzle 2 answer validation unchanged
cases.method: submit wrong answer '10' then correct answer '4' at the relocated terminal
cases.expected: wrong rejected with hint message, correct accepted, f(x)=3x-2 unchanged

cases.name: Player can descend and cross the opened gate after solving
cases.method: roof-e3 -> roof-e4 (drop 140, unchanged from V6.1) -> street (drop 60, unchanged from V6.1) -> walk through the now-open rooftop-gate to checkpoint 2

cases.name: Puzzle state persists after leaving the rooftop / falling
cases.method: checked via the same solvedGates Set used by every other puzzle (no per-zone special-casing added); covered indirectly by the R-restart regression already in probe.py, which asserts all 3 solved gates persist through a checkpoint reset

cases.name: Zone B: deliberate failed jump off awning-b1 recovers safely
cases.method: walk off awning-b1's edge with no jump input
cases.expected: lands on continuous street, feet=1000, no respawn

cases.name: Zone B: real descending jump lands on awning-b2
Zone B: lower street remains walkable/unobstructed (no manufactured obstacle)
cases.method: teleport to (1440, mid-span under the awnings), confirm grounded at feet=1000

cases.name: Zone E: deliberate failed jump off roof-e1 recovers safely
cases.method: walk off roof-e1's edge with no jump input
cases.expected: lands on continuous recovery street, feet=1000

cases.name: routePlatforms count matches implemented deck/street total
cases.note: 9 decks (awning-b1, awning-b2, cafe-roof, roof-e1..e4, hill-plateau, gua-alcove) + 4 continuous street segments; was 14 before awning-b3's removal

cases.name: Full level completion still achievable
cases.method: full natural-input playthrough, spawn to GOAL, all 3 puzzles solved, all 3 checkpoints reached

cases.name: No console/page/network errors introduced
cases.method: playwright pageerror/console/requestfailed listeners across the entire desktop + mobile + missing-asset + Add Math-shell run

unit_tests.new_test: Machine 2 sits on roof-e3 and is unreachable from the street or any other deck (V6.2)

known_unrelated_failure.issue: Fixture resets the player to x=1350, a ladder position from V5 (pre-V6.1) geometry that has not existed since V6.1 shipped (V6.1 moved Zone B's ladders to x=1280/1850). Confirmed pre-existing: awning-b1 (x:1250-1370) and the ladder-up (x:1280) are both unchanged by this V6.2 pass, so this fixture's drift predates this work and is unrelated to it. Left unmodified per this pass's scope (no unrelated source changes).
